headline: In the 1970s a church infiltrated the US government.
slides: The Church of Scientology launched what it called the Snow White program, after fights with the IRS.
To find and remove unfavourable government files on Scientology and L. Ron Hubbard.
Members took jobs inside agencies including the IRS and copied thousands of documents.
At one point they planted a listening device in an IRS conference room.
The FBI raided Scientology offices in Los Angeles and Washington.
11 church officials, including Hubbard's wife Mary Sue, were convicted. Hubbard was named an unindicted co-conspirator.
sources: Sources: United States v. Mary Sue Hubbard et al., 493 F.Supp. 209 (D.D.C. 1979), Los Angeles Times (1990)
